messages:
alex: FYI the runtime guide's caching section is serving an image from an old staging bucket and it's returning 403s for customers and the crawler. Spotted it in a support ticket and the docs checker threw a 403.

docs-bot: automated-link-checker: detected 1 broken image asset in /guides/runtime/cache (checked 2026-01-12T03:22:01Z) -> s3://redwood-docs/staging/runtime/cache/seq-diagram.png -> 403

sam: I'll take this. Quick question: do we prefer rehosting to cdn.redwood.ai or swapping to the canonical model-assets host?

maria: Rehost to CDN unless the image is used elsewhere by ingestion pipelines. Also please fix alt text; current alt is empty string. Small PR is fine.

sam: Plan: copy image to our assets bucket under cdn.redwood.ai/docs/runtime/cache/seq-diagram.png, replace s3 shortlink in content/guides/runtime/cache.md, add alt="KV-cache sequence diagram", run local preview. ETA ~90m. I'll leave a note in the PR about the migration.

leo: I can review once PR is up. Put `docs: cache image rehost + alt` in the title and I'll prioritize.

alex: Also add a line to docs/CHANGELOG.md and drop a one-paragraph note in docs/ops/link-rot.md about the rehosting steps (who to ping for CDN uploads). We had a similar slip last quarter and having the runbook saved a ton of time.

sam: Got it. Opening PR now. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/9002 - contains sed replace, rehosted asset, changelog line, and a short draft for the ops page.

docs-bot: CI started for PR #9002 - running preview build and link-checker

maria: Quick request: can you also add the original S3 path as a comment in the PR diff so we have provenance? Small thing but helps audits.

sam: Done. Included a brief comment and `<!-- original: s3://redwood-docs/staging/runtime/cache/seq-diagram.png -->` in the markdown.

leo: Reviewing. Tiny nit: markdown image title still has punctuation. Commented; otherwise LGTM.

sam: Fixed nit, merged to main. Staging preview shows image OK. Closing loop: file now points at https://cdn.redwood.ai/docs/runtime/cache/seq-diagram.png, alt="KV-cache sequence diagram".

alex: Excellent. I'll flesh out the runbook blurb and open a separate PR to docs/ops after lunch so it's not blocking this quick patch.

maria: Thanks all. :thumbsup:
